products.name: Epic Pass
products.summary: Vail Resorts' full season pass for 2026-27: unlimited, unrestricted skiing at Vail Resorts' own North American resorts (including Vail, Breckenridge, Park City and Whistler Blackcomb) and at Perisher, Falls Creek and Hotham for the June–October 2027 Australian winter, plus a limited number of consecutive days at partner resorts in Europe and Japan (search summaries of OnTheSnow's 2026-27 buyer's guide). Price and sales deadline not found.
products.blackoutsSummary: No blackout dates at Vail Resorts' own North American resorts ("unlimited, unrestricted", search summary). Partner resorts in Europe and Japan allow a limited number of consecutive days instead.

source.note: Summarised from the 2026-27 search summaries recorded on 2026-09-30 (OnTheSnow buyer's guide, Undercover Tourist, SnowBrains resort list); not re-checked on 2026-10-03 because the pass sites were unreachable. Price and sales deadline not found.

products.name: Epic Local Pass
products.summary: Vail Resorts' lower-priced season pass for 2026-27 (search summaries of Undercover Tourist and OnTheSnow): unlimited, unrestricted skiing at resorts such as Breckenridge and Keystone; unlimited skiing at Park City except on holiday-restricted dates; holiday restrictions also listed for Heavenly, Northstar, Kirkwood and Stowe; and 10 days in total, with peak-date restrictions, shared by Vail, Beaver Creek and Whistler Blackcomb. Price and sales deadline not found.
products.blackoutsSummary: Holiday-restricted dates for 2026-27: Nov 27–28, 2026; Dec 26–31, 2026; Jan 16, 2027; Feb 13–14, 2027 (search summary). Whistler Blackcomb publishes its own holiday-restricted dates, so check its page.

source.note: Summarised from the 2026-27 search summaries recorded on 2026-09-30 (Undercover Tourist, OnTheSnow buyer's guide, epicpass.com restricted peak dates page); not re-checked on 2026-10-03 because the pass sites were unreachable. Price and sales deadline not found.
